text:
Type: industrial swivel work chair
Use: working at a desk, crafts, drawing; home office, study, studio
Style: industrial, rustic, Scandinavian
Materials: solid pine seat and backrest with a clear lacquer, black powder-coated steel frame, height-adjustable center column
Colors: light honey pine, matte black
Shape: small rectangular wooden backrest on a looped steel rod, flat seat, armless, four splayed steel legs joined by a round footring, open and light, compact
Feel: utilitarian, crafted, warm, vintage
Goes with: raw wood desks, black metal, concrete or brick walls; industrial or rustic home offices and studios

product.name: KULLABERG
product.description: A desk chair inspired by old-fashioned industrial-style chairs, complete with modern functions.
